tours.ala-archa.name: Ala-Archa National Park
tours.ala-archa.description: Walk alpine trails to a panoramic waterfall and breathe the crisp mountain air beneath the snowy Tien Shan peaks. A perfect first day in Kyrgyzstan.

tours.pio-peak.name: Lenin Peak and the Meridian Trail
tours.pio-peak.description: Discover one of Kyrgyzstan’s best-known mountain areas, with glaciers, a high pass and sweeping views across the Pamir ranges.

tours.asan-basky.name: Asan-Basy Valley
tours.asan-basky.description: A quiet valley of high pastures and snowy slopes, ideal for a short yet refreshing escape into the mountains.

tours.lenin-trail.name: Tien Shan Trail to Kel-Suu Lake
tours.lenin-trail.description: Follow a striking route through alpine meadows and mountain passes to a clear high-altitude lake, with plenty of time to enjoy the scenery.

tours.issyk-kul.name: Lake Issyk-Kul
tours.issyk-kul.description: Enjoy a morning beside Kyrgyzstan’s great mountain lake, sandy beaches and snow-capped peaks, with welcoming guesthouses and local culture along the way.

tours.son-kul.name: High-Altitude Son-Kul Lake
tours.son-kul.description: Experience nomadic life at 3,016 metres: sleep in a yurt beneath the stars, ride across open pastures and enjoy the quiet of the highlands.

tours.chatyr-kul.name: Chatyr-Kul Lake
tours.chatyr-kul.description: Discover a remote high-mountain lake of wide-open views, fresh winds and starry nights in a traditional nomadic camp.

tours.kashka-suu.name: Kashka-Suu Lake and Mountain Escape
tours.kashka-suu.description: Take an easy break by the water, walk to a waterfall and enjoy a relaxed outdoor trip suited to families.

tours.jyrgalan.name: Jyrgalan Valley
tours.jyrgalan.description: Walk through green pastures and beneath snowy peaks on quiet trails far from the crowds. A lovely place for fresh air and an easy hike.

tours.ala-kul.name: Trek to Ala-Kul Lake
tours.ala-kul.description: Cross mountain passes and alpine meadows before reaching a crystal-clear lake on this rewarding trek for experienced hikers.

tours.kara-mazar.name: Kara-Mazar Trail
tours.kara-mazar.description: Follow calm mountain paths through vivid wildflowers, with riverside stops and a comfortable pace for different fitness levels.

tours.seren-peak.name: Trek in the Seren Mountain Range
tours.seren-peak.description: A rewarding high-altitude adventure with steep climbs, remote landscapes and star-filled nights for travelers who love the outdoors.

tours.skazka.name: Fairy Tale Canyon
tours.skazka.description: Explore red rock formations beside Issyk-Kul that glow at sunset. The easy walk offers unforgettable views and great photo spots.

tours.toraygyr.name: Toraygyr Canyon
tours.toraygyr.description: Sandstone walls and sunlit, colorful hills create a distinctive setting for an active getaway and memorable photographs.

tours.jeti-oguz.name: Jeti-Oguz Canyon
tours.jeti-oguz.description: Enjoy a scenic route through dramatic rock formations and mountain scenery, with a relaxed pace and beautiful stops.

tours.myn-tala.name: Myn-Tala Canyon
tours.myn-tala.description: Spend a comfortable day among striking rock formations and ever-changing landscapes on an easy, photo-friendly route.

tours.sary-chet.name: Sary-Chet Saymaluu Canyon
tours.sary-chet.description: Take on a challenging route across rugged terrain, high passes and long panoramic ridgelines.

tours.song-kul-horse.name: Horseback Ride in the Tien Shan
tours.song-kul-horse.description: Ride ancient mountain trails with an experienced local guide, who will match the route to your ability and share nomadic traditions.

tours.rafting-chui.name: White-Water Rafting on the Chu River
tours.rafting-chui.description: Enjoy an energetic but guided rafting trip through lively rapids and calmer stretches, framed by broad gravel banks.

tours.paragliding.name: Paragliding over Lake Issyk-Kul
tours.paragliding.description: Soar above vivid blue water with snowy peaks on the horizon in one of Kyrgyzstan’s most scenic adventures.

tours.horse-steppe.name: Nomadic Horse Trail
tours.horse-steppe.description: Meet local families, stay in yurts and ride across open steppe to experience the rhythms and traditions of nomadic life.

tours.mountain-bike.name: Mountain Bike Ride over a High Pass
tours.mountain-bike.description: Ride challenging descents with wide views of the mountain ranges, then spend the night at a high-altitude camp.

tours.karakol.name: Karakol and the Tien Shan Gorges
tours.karakol.description: Explore historic Karakol, nearby mountain gorges and forest trails at the foot of the Tien Shan with a local guide.

tours.sary-chelek.name: Sary-Chelek Lake
tours.sary-chelek.description: Visit a protected mountain lake surrounded by walnut forests, quiet coves and the landscapes of a UNESCO biosphere reserve.

tours.arslanbob.name: Arslanbob Walnut Forests
tours.arslanbob.description: Walk through vast walnut forests, visit waterfalls and discover the welcoming culture of local communities.

tours.tash-rabat.name: Tash-Rabat Caravanserai
tours.tash-rabat.description: Visit a medieval stone caravanserai on the Silk Road, set among the broad high-altitude valleys of Naryn.

tours.kel-suu.name: Kel-Suu Lake
tours.kel-suu.description: See a turquoise lake enclosed by sheer cliffs. The route includes a drive through a high mountain valley and time by the water.

tours.burana.name: Burana Tower and Ancient Balasagun
tours.burana.description: Learn about the medieval city of Balasagun, visit Burana’s minaret and see ancient stone statues.

tours.bishkek.name: Bishkek: Parks, Markets and City Life
tours.bishkek.description: Discover leafy boulevards, central squares and lively markets in the capital with a knowledgeable local guide.

tours.chunkurchak.name: Chunkurchak Gorge
tours.chunkurchak.description: Just outside Bishkek, enjoy pine forests, mountain meadows, panoramic views and easy trails in the fresh air.
